summary: Month-grid date picker for single dates or ranges, with a springing pixel selection block, a dotted range band and a mark on today.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection: `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD` with `range`. Use with `onValueChange`. A new value also shows its month.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection when uncontrolled; it also sets the month shown. A form reset restores it.

props.name: range
props.description: Pick a start and an end date instead of a single date. Switching it reads the selection from `value` again.

props.name: firstDay
props.description: First day of the week, from `0` (Sunday) to `6`. The default is Monday.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. A range submits as `start/end` and stays empty until both ends are picked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the calendar and disables its buttons.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a date is picked; in range mode only when the end date is picked.

keyboard.action: Move to the previous / next day.
Move to the previous / next week.
Move to the first / last day of the week.
Move to the same day in the previous / next month, clamped to its length (31 January moves to 28 February).
Move to the same day in the previous / next year, clamped the same way.

accessibility: Days are native buttons with `role="gridcell"` in `role="row"` weeks inside a `role="grid"` container labelled by the month title.
Each day has an `aria-label` with the full date ("Saturday, 24 October 2026") and `aria-selected` for the selected start and end; today has `aria-current="date"`.
Roving tabindex: only the focused day is in the tab order. Moving past the edge of the month shows the next month and keeps focus on the new day.
The month title is an `aria-live="polite"` region; the arrow buttons are labelled "Previous month" and "Next month".
The weekday header and the selection canvas are `aria-hidden`.
motion: With reduced motion the month grid swaps without sliding, the selection block jumps instead of springing, and the title and summary swap without rolling.
form: With `name`, a hidden input submits `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD` with `range`, which stays empty until both ends are picked. There is no validation. Form reset restores `defaultValue` and shows its month.
notes: In range mode, picking a date before the start makes it the new start, and hovering after the start previews the band.
The Today button shows the current month and picks today. Today is read in the browser, so server markup carries no today mark; without a value the grid fills in after hydration.
The summary line, for example "20 Oct – Sat, 24 Oct 2026 · 4 nights", and all labels are in English. Dates use local time.
A range `value` written end first is put in order. Dates that do not exist, such as `2026-02-31`, are ignored.
